_terminology: Mapping and extraction terminology, added 2026-08-19 under the owner's
publishability tasking (AUTO_MODE_DECISIONS.md #18-#21). Every term is drawn
from the cited source clause's own wording or names the clause type
generically; no term encodes a legal position (rules 7/21 - positions live
in `configuration`, sourced above). confirm_threshold 5 is STRUCTURAL: one
exact phrase confirms, or a section heading plus a keyword group. Locked
35.9 fixes no threshold and 35.10 requires calibration against a
representative contract set before the value is trusted; recalibration is a
new mapping rule version (data), never a code change.
_legal_rule_note: APPROVED ZERO-TOLERANCE LEGAL RULE (manager ruling 2026-08-19; owner
approval to wire, 2026-08-20). MATCH -> ACCEPTABLE (no decision needed);
ANY deviation -- unlimited included -> UNACCEPTABLE -> Legal Decision
required; nothing that differs is ever auto-approved. There are
deliberately NO thresholds and NO tolerance bands: do not add
acceptable_max or approval_required_above, and do not ask for them --
the policy is that none exists. Wired as deviation_outcome +
unlimited_outcome, both read by the evaluators; an unrecognised value
fails closed to NOT_APPLICABLE and a human (ENG-09, Step 20 r4).
